subject: Staged pin policy + rollback comms for Private deployments
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tara Malik <tara@acme-health.com>, ops@acme-health.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged pin policy + rollback comms for Private deployments

Tara / Acme ops team —

Following up from yesterday's call: attached is a proposed staged pin & rollback communications plan for your Private deployment (draft v2). High level goals: keep your production inference stable during minor patch windows, provide a clearly automated rollback path, and minimize cross-region blast radius.

Key asks from Acme for this review:
- Confirm maintenance windows (we suggested 02:00-06:00 UTC local)
- Sign off on canary cadence (5% -> 25% -> 100%)
- Accept the retention of one previous model pin for immediate fallback

Quick summary of the plan attached:
- Preflight: KV cache snapshot + traffic mirror test for 12 hours
- Canary: 5% traffic to patched pool for 30m, monitor latency/error budget and content regressions
- Ramp: 25% for 60m, then 100% if OK
- Rollback: automatic on SLO breach or manual with 15-minute circuit-breaker window

Attachments: staged-pin-policy-v2.docx, patch_matrix.xlsx, private-runbook-v3.md

Please review the doc and confirm the windows that work for you. If you want, we can run a rehearsal in the sandbox a week before the planned window.

Thanks,
Monica
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Tara Malik <tara@acme-health.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme-health.com, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Staged pin policy + rollback comms for Private deployments

Monica —

Thanks for the thorough draft. A few quick items from Acme ops/security: 
1) Our preferred maintenance window is 01:00-05:00 UTC; the team can shift but prefers earlier.
2) We need SOC2-relevant evidence for the automatic rollback trigger — can you point to what audit events get emitted and where logs land?
3) For canary, we want a shorter first step (5% for 15m) and a mandatory manual checkpoint before the 25% ramp — our clinical service owners want to opt-in at that point.

We can do a rehearsal in sandbox Oct 27-28. I'll need the rehearsal runbook and a list of the exact Cloud/VPC IP ranges you will access (for our firewall rules).

Tara Malik
SRE Manager, Acme Health
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tara Malik <tara@acme-health.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged pin policy + rollback comms for Private deployments

Tara / team —

Quick technical clarifications and where evidence shows up: 
- Audit & logs: rollback triggers, pin changes, and canary metrics generate events in the Private control plane audit log (exported to your S3 bucket or our secure transfer endpoint). Events: PIN_UPDATE, CANARY_RAMP, ROLLBACK_TRIGGER, CIRCUIT_BREAKER_OPEN.
- Telemetry & alerts: Console emits token-level latency/error and per-route accuracy monitors. We will wire a dedicated PagerDuty channel for the rehearsal and run windows.
- Canary timing: we can change first step to 15m. We will also add a required manual approval before 25% ramp — implemented as a console gate with an auto-escalate timer set to 60m.
- Rollback mechanics:
  - Immediate: revert to previous model pin (zero-downtime switch via router)
  - Cache handling: KV cache flush + rolling warmup; expected ~5 minutes to warm under typical traffic
  - Fallback: if rollback fails, traffic will be routed to hosted fallback pool (if customer enabled hosted fallback) or to the last known stable snapshot.

Firewall IPs: see link to the runbook and attached patch_matrix for tentative egress IP ranges. I'll attach the latest runbook (private-runbook-v3.md) with step-by-step commands and expected console flags.

Dev
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Tara Malik <tara@acme-health.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:08:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Staged pin policy + rollback comms for Private deployments

Following up with a proposed schedule aligned to Acme's preferred window (01:00-05:00 UTC):

Proposed date: 2026-10-30 (dry run in sandbox on 2026-10-27)
Sequence:
- 00:00-00:30 (prep): config push, snapshot KV, start traffic mirror for 12h
- 00:30-00:45 (canary step 1): 5% -> monitor 15m
- 00:45-01:45 (post-check): manual approval gate (up to 60m)
- 01:45-02:45 (ramp): 25% for 60m -> if green, continue to 100% over 30m
- 03:15 onwards (observe): 4h observation window with extended telemetry retention for 72h

Canary and rollback observability: we will enable an extended trace sample rate for the canary cluster and export the SLO metrics to Acme's Prometheus endpoint (pushgateway) for the rehearsal and real run. Naomi — we'll need your ok on the audit event retention (72h default, can extend to 30d for this run).

Jonas
Principal Deployments Engineer
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tara Malik <tara@acme-health.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, ops@acme-health.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged pin policy + rollback comms for Private deployments

Thanks all — summary and next steps (agreed):
- Maintenance window: 2026-10-30 01:00-05:00 UTC (sandbox dry run 2026-10-27)
- Canary cadence: 5% for 15m, manual approval gate before 25% (max wait 60m), then 25% for 60m -> gradual to 100%
- Rollback: immediate automated pin revert on SLO breach (audit events emitted: ROLLBACK_TRIGGER); manual fallback to hosted pool if needed
- Observability: extended traces + export to Acme Prometheus; audit logs retained 72h (Naomi, please confirm if we should extend to 30d)
- Firewall/IPs & rehearsal access: Dev to send exact IP list and a per-run ephemeral ssh key by 2026-10-22

Action owners:
- Dev Patel: finalize runbook + IP list (due 2026-10-22)
- Jonas Weber: schedule rehearsal and configure Prometheus export (due 2026-10-23)
- Naomi Feldman: confirm audit retention window & compliance evidence format (due 2026-10-21)
- Tara / Acme: confirm rehearsal slot and validate opt-in process for clinical owners (due 2026-10-20)

I'll convert this thread into a shared checklist in the Drive link and create a HubSpot note attached to HS-18392.

Thanks,
Monica
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
